display_name: Phousik, companion of Simeon of Persia

names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 17 Απριλίου, «Άγιος Συμεών επίσκοπος Περσίας και οι μαρτυρήσαντες μαζί μ' αυτόν Αύδελας ο πρεσβύτερος, Γοθαζάτ, Φουσίκ και άλλοι 1150».

Read out of the title on the name link behind the line for 17 апреля ст. ст., name page 2341, «Фусик Селевкийский, мч.», with the rank word and the office left off; the day's own line gives the name in the genitive, «Фусика». No folder in this corpus holds this form, and the gate's key for it has no other holder, measured. The city is the calendar's own nominative and is kept.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 17 апреля ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Симеона , еп. Персидского, и с ним мчч. @6[Авделая] и Анании пресвитеров, Хусдазата евнуха, Фусика , Азата , мч. Аскитреи и иных многих (344).»
source.note: The day's first entry, and the first of the three to carry a typikon icon. **Its life gives him a daughter, which no source read for this folder had done**: «вместе со святым Фусиком была замучена и его дочь мученица Аскитрея», and she is the sixth name on the day's line and now has a folder of her own. The line enumerates six of the company and closes «и иных многих», and many others, who are not named; the life counts a thousand martyrs, then another hundred and another hundred and fifty. **The day page's markup for the first presbyter is broken — it prints «@6[Авделая]», an unexpanded template, and he alone of the six has no `name:` link behind him.** The name page for the entry (2001) gives «День памяти: 17 апреля» and no other day, and its «Служба» line names the three the day's service is for: the bishop, Acacius of Melitene and Zosimas of Solovki. None of the day's four hymns is this company's. Two of the company had no folder here before this batch and now have one.

attestations.note: Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 17ης Απριλίου — «Άγιος Συμεών επίσκοπος Περσίας και οι μαρτυρήσαντες μαζί μ' αυτόν Αύδελας ο πρεσβύτερος, Γοθαζάτ, Φουσίκ και άλλοι 1150»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 17 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. Four men are named in the line and each has a couplet of his own, so four folders; the other 1150 are named nowhere and have none. The page gives no year: it sets them only in the reign of the Persian king it calls Σαβώριος and Σαπώρ ο Β’, so there is no `dates` object. `office` is the page's own word for his place at court, «ο κουροπαλατής του βασιλιά». The corpus holds nobody of this name.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).

death.note: The first year any source read for this folder gives him, and this folder had no `dates` at all. days.pravoslavie.ru closes the line for 17 апреля ст. ст. with «(344)», and its life for the company dates the decree that began the persecution to 344 and the bishop's own death to «13 апреля 344», with the killing continuing through Pascha week to the twenty-third of April. This martyr died inside that week. The Greek page this folder was written from gave no year at all.
